title: Merge Arbitration — agent narrative input
description: Written by the merge-arbiter agent to .github/.pipeline-context/merge/<issue_id>.arbitration.json after reading <issue_id>.score.json (the deterministic score, gates, and computed decision from compute-score.js). Consumed by scripts/render-verdict.js. The score and computed decision are facts this file does not restate or alter directly — the only way to change the outcome is the explicit, always-visible override object below.

narrative.description: Plain-language explanation of the decision: what the five checks found, why the score/gates land where they do, and what a reviewer should read first if they want to understand this patch's readiness in one paragraph.

applied.description: False by default — the computed decision stands. Set true only when you are contesting the computed score/gate outcome with a specific, evidenced reason. An override is never silent: render-verdict.js always shows both the computed decision and the override side by side.

decision.description: Required when applied is true. The decision you are asserting instead of the computed one.

reason.description: Required when applied is true. Must cite specific evidence from one or more of the five upstream reports — never a general feeling of confidence or caution.
